title: Hillel, Disciple of Rava
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In [Beitzah 26b](https://www.sefaria.org/Beitzah.26b.9) he asks Rava a question. In [Pesachim 115a](https://www.sefaria.org/Pesachim.115a.3), Ravina says, “Rav Mesharshya, son of Rav Natan, told me: This is what Hillel said from received tradition.” In [Nazir 44b](https://www.sefaria.org/Nazir.44b.3) and [Gittin 37a](https://www.sefaria.org/Gittin.37a.4), too, “Hillel taught.” Hyman suggests that this may be Rava’s disciple; Rashi there explains that he was an Amora.

notes.text: The opening כ is a citation preposition, not 20; שבעי means “who asked,” not a person called Shevai. Beitzah 26b explicitly names Hillel asking Rava.
